scoring_justification: Recompute gamma from the agent's raw (epsilon,M) data using log-log linear regression, compare to paper-reported gamma=0.74 for alpha=0.5 with tolerance ±0.1, and verify fit quality.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Figure 5(a) caption: 'frustrated mass as function of cutoff ... with exponent gamma=0.74 for alpha=0.5'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the actual value the paper reports for the same quantity under the same conditions.

outputs.description: Raw data of particle size cutoff epsilon versus total frustrated mass M, from which the checker will fit a power law and extract the scaling exponent gamma.

output_contract.notes: The checker will perform log-log linear regression on the submitted (epsilon, M) pairs, extract the slope gamma, and compare it to a hidden reference value with a tolerance. It will also require a minimum number of data points and a fit R² threshold.

steps.description: Recompute the scaling exponent gamma from the CSV and compare to reference, ensuring sufficient fit quality.
